facts.fact: Egypt's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology announced the pilot launch of Karnak Chat, a chatbot built on its Karnak model, open to users by web registration or a Google Play app.

systems.platform: chatbot on the Karnak large language model
systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

facts.fact: The ministry says Karnak, a large language model developed at its Applied Innovation Center by retraining open-source models on Egyptian and Arab data, now underlies the Karnak Chat pilot released to users.

systems.owner: Applied Innovation Center, Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
